message: Design candidate SpCas9 guides to disrupt PCSK9 and compare on-target and genome-wide off-target risk.

message: Design candidate SpCas9 guides at the EMX1 locus used in off-target benchmarking; enumerate near matches and do not call zero reported hits proof of specificity.

must_contain.claim: Report genome-wide search assembly, mismatch budget, individual off-target loci and CFD-like scores, and search-completeness limitations.

message: Design candidate guides for a VEGFA exon and compare predicted off-target sites with the limitations exposed by GUIDE-seq benchmarks.

message: Propose candidate guides to disrupt the erythroid BCL11A enhancer for research on fetal-hemoglobin induction; preserve enhancer coordinates and review gating.

message: Design candidate SpCas9 guides at CCR5 and explicitly evaluate known high-similarity off-target risk before ranking a pool.

message: Design candidate SpCas9 guides to disrupt lacZ in E. coli K-12 MG1655, using the named bacterial assembly and checking all genomic near matches.

message: Design candidate guides for the AAVS1/PPP1R12C safe-harbor region and rank them with genome-wide off-target evidence.

must_contain.claim: Preserve exact assembly coordinates, report off-targets, and avoid calling any genomic site universally safe.

message: Design candidate guides at the mouse Rosa26 locus using GRCm39 and no human off-target index.

message: Design candidate guides near the circular chromosome origin and check chromosome plus pGOX plasmids for off-targets.

message: Design a base edit at HBB but omit the assembly and desired ref-to-alt edit.
